fact: On 3 August 2023 the Deputy Minister of Health said many systems fail to exchange data from one facility to another, and called on the new Tanzania Health Information Agency (TAHIA) to deliver one system that reads across all facilities from national hospital to dispensary.
title: DKT. MOLLEL ASISITIZA KUWEPO MFUMO MMOJA WA TAARIFA KATIKA SEKTA YA AFYA
